name: project-factory
description: Self-improving, spec-driven multi-agent delivery framework as a plugin. v2 adds the self-improvement layer: acceptance-method escrow, three-valued gates (NOT-EARNED), process-health ledger, correction intake, lessons library, factory-integrity lock, and the visual-parity playbook (multi-layer L1-L5 acceptance, block-conquest, continuum sweep). An orchestrator skill drives 11 specialized subagents and 5 deterministic workflows through a gated lifecycle (requirements -> OpenSpec specs -> capability slices -> test-first build -> adversarial review -> output+trajectory evals -> QA proof -> UAT) with a trace chain, ratchets, and cost-tiered automations. Add it to a new or existing repo: /project-factory:init scaffolds the loop for greenfield; /project-factory:onboard retrofits an existing codebase (reverse-engineers requirements + baseline specs). The skill then runs the whole delivery under its control.
